title: Pumpkin Bird vs Knight
description: A young knight in dark armor with orange accents swings a glowing warhammer at a furious, winged pumpkin creature with pink wings and a clenched fist. The creature appears to have just been struck, emitting a yellow "CRACK!" burst. The scene is set in a magical garden with glowing flowers, broken pottery, lavender, and lightning in a starry night sky.
prompt: A dramatic fantasy battle scene at night: a determined young Black knight in dark armor with orange straps and green pouches swings a large glowing warhammer at an angry flying pumpkin creature with large pink feathered wings, clenched fist, and open beak. The pumpkin is exploding with yellow sparks and a "CRACK!" effect. They are surrounded by a magical garden with purple lavender, broken blue pottery sprouting plants, large glowing pink and orange flowers, under a black sky with purple lightning. Vibrant comic book style with strong outlines and glowing effects.
